description: This Python module provides functions to find files used by testing frameworks, specifically for 'run-webkit-tests' and 'perftestrunner'. It includes a main function 'find' that searches directories with options for filtering and sorting, utilizing glob patterns and directory skipping.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds test files under specified paths with options for filtering skipped directories, applying a filter callback, and sorting.

methods.name: _normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a list of paths relative to a base directory using the filesystem's methods.

methods.name: _normalized_find
methods.description: Performs the actual search for files under given paths, applying glob patterns, skipping directories, filtering, and sorting.
